description: Formula/*.rb is generated by the release automation, so the homebrew manager stays off: edits there are overwritten at the next release.

packageRules.description: The SLIM crates must move together: slim_auth 0.14 caps below 0.15 while slim_rpc 2.3 requires it, which puts two versions in the tree and breaks the TokenProvider bounds.
Workspace crates are released by the repo's own automation.
Low-risk bumps in one PR to keep the review load down.
